(Kelsen himself seems to have changed his views about this over the years; he may have started with a kind of neo-Kantian perspective one can discern in PT1, and gradually shifted to a Humean version of his main argument, which is quite evident in GT. spot.html_text: Every two norms that ultimately derive their validity from one basic norm belong to the same legal system. All legal norms of a given legal system ultimately derive their validity from one basic norm.
